content: It is essential to take each dose of this medication as scheduled. If you miss an injection, contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately to establish a new dosing schedule. If you miss an inhaled dose, use it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your next dose at the regular time. If you are using colistimethate as an inhalation, store the unmixed vials at room temperature. Do not use premixed solutions or prepare the solution in advance, as this increases the risk of severe respiratory complications. Always prepare the inhalation solution immediately before use. Discard any unused solution after 24 hours, and do not store it for longer periods. Avoid storing the medication in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. For guidance on disposal, consult your pharmacist or local waste disposal company. This information was last revised in May 2024. It is important to note that this is a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. In the event of an overdose, if the individual has severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Laboratory and/or medical tests, such as kidney function tests, should be conducted while you are using this medication. Ensure that you attend all medical and laboratory appointments as scheduled.
